data.long_meaning: A place where the land meets the sea, often characterized by sandy shores, calm waters, and sunny skies. The name Beach carries the meaning “Coastal place” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Beach usually hope their child will grow to embody coastal place and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The beach as a cultural concept carries a significantWeight in popular imagination and is associated with relaxation, recreation, and beauty. It is a place of escape from the daily grind and a reminder of the vastness and power of nature. The beach also holds a special place in the arts, inspiring countless works of music, literature, and visual arts.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian symbolism, the beach takes on a deeper meaning as a representation of the threshold between the earthly world and the spiritual realm. It is a place of reflection, contemplation, and prayer, where one can connect with God and find inner peace. The crashing waves and vast expanse of water can symbolize the mysteries and depths of God, while the sun and sand represent the beauty and comfort of His presence. The beach can also be seen as a metaphor for the Christian life, with the challenges and trials of the earthly world giving way to the promise and joy of the spiritual realm.
